cohort: Women giving birth at Sioux Lookout Meno Ya Win Health Centre (SLMHC) from 2012 to 2017
finding: Despite a higher prevalence of risk factors for cesarean delivery, SLMHC had lower cesarean delivery rates and higher VBAC rates compared to other hospitals, suggesting that VBAC can be safely performed in a rural setting with appropriate screening and monitoring.
mod_finding: SLMHC had significantly higher VBAC rates (31% vs. 16%) and women were twice as likely to choose a trial of labor after cesarean.
